Platform

△
Notes:
[Error]: SecurityErrorDomain::kInvalidArgument if algId argument specifies a crypto algorithm
different from symmetric stream cipher
[Error]: SecurityErrorDomain::kUnknownIdentifier if algId argument has an unsupported value
[Error]: SecurityErrorDomain::kBusyResource if the slot specified by reservedIndex is busy yet
[Error]: SecurityErrorDomain::kUnreservedResource if the slot specified by reservedIndex was
not allocated
[Error]: SecurityErrorDomain::kInsufficientResource if size of the slot specified by reserved
Index is not enough for placing of the target context
[Error]: SecurityErrorDomain::kBadAlloc if (reservedIndex == kAllocObjectOnHeap), but
allocation memory on the heap is impossible
